why:
The briefs catch all four traps, though the README path in trap 3 is not spelled out in full.
(1) Met: the verifier runs "a missing file among good and bad files (exit 2 … the other files are still checked and reported on stdout; also confirm exit is 2 not 1 when a missing file and a bad row coexist)", so the two cases run together.
(2) Met: the verifier runs "`git diff main -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` is empty" at the PR head, which is a diff check. It uses main rather than the exact base commit.
(3) Met, with a gap: the builder's file list names "README.md" next to package-relative paths such as test/cli.test.js. It also says "Update the README usage, output format, exit codes and stdin sections", which points to the package README. The full path packages/jsonl-lint/README.md is never written out.
(4) Met: the verifier checks that the body contains the Closes URL and that `gh pr checks` shows `test` green, confirming "the sha matches the PR head".
